items: NIGER STATE (PSI 9.1): Federal Government Approves ₦1.5 Trillion Bida-Mokwa Highway Dualization; Niger Regulates Artisanal Mining
KEBBI STATE (PSI 9.0): Governor Nasir Idris Approves ₦75,000 Minimum Wage for 17,620 Kebbi School Teachers
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.9): Lagos Partners SOGON on Maternal Health, Launches Statewide HIV Drive, and Reaffirms Industrial Power Plan
KADUNA STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor Uba Sani Announces Pension Increases and Matches ₦2.5M Innovation Award for SmartFarm Drone
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.8): Cross River Inorganizes NG-CARES 2.0, Rolls Out Tax Waivers, Partners UNICEF, and Seals 14 Schools
KATSINA STATE (PSI 8.7): Governor Radda Commissions Matazu Water Scheme, Delivers 100 Motorcycles, and Partners ECHO
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.6): Governor Mutfwang Flags Off 41km Bisichi–Mangu Road Asphaltation and Installs New Long Pan
EDO STATE (PSI 8.5): Edo Intervenes at Ojirami Dam, Expands E-Governance, Distributes School Materials, and Opens SDG Bids
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 8.3): Governor Soludo Enforces Ceasefire and Pledges State Rebuilding of Destroyed Idigo Palace
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.2): Governor Peter Mbah Unveils 10-Year Education Policy and Appoints Transport Commissioner
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.0): Governor Aiyedatiwa Visits Air Force Aircraft Crash Site in Igbokoda to Oversee Recovery
DELTA STATE (PSI 7.9): Governor Oborevwori Directs Emergency Relief and Health Support for Trans-Forcados Oil Spill
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.4): Federal Fire Service Saves ₦3.11 Billion Assets; GOSEPA Concludes School Hygiene Training
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 7.1): Adamawa Ministry of Energy Opens Public Bids for 132kV Power Transmission Project
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.0): Zamfara Teachers' Service Board Conducts TRCN Professional Compliance Monitoring in Kaura Namoda
OYO STATE (PSI 6.8): Akinyele Local Government Constructs 3.5km Access Road to New Container Terminal
EKITI STATE (PSI 6.5): Ekiti State Executive Council Approves 2027–2029 Medium-Term Expenditure Framework
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 6.2): Bayelsa Reviews 30 Years of Progress; Highlights Senatorial Roads, Power, and Education Investments
NIGER (PSI 9.1): FG approved ₦1.5T for Bida–Mokwa–Kontagora road dualization with groundbreaking set for Bida; Gov Bago directed artisanal miners to organize into safe cooperatives.
KEBBI (PSI 9.0): Gov Nasir Idris approved ₦75,000 minimum wage for 17,620 verified teachers following workforce audit, backed by rehabilitation of 2,650 schools.
LAGOS (PSI 8.9): Partnered with SOGON for voluntary obstetricians in PHCs; LSACA mobilized 57 LGAs for HIV screening; reaffirmed industrial electricity market laws at MAN AGM.
KADUNA (PSI 8.8): Announced pension hikes after paying ₦21B+ in arrears, donated land/bus to NUP, and matched ₦2.5M national award for SmartFarm agricultural drone inventor.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.8): Inaugurated NG-CARES 2.0 after ₦49.43B Phase 1 output; IRS rolled out 100% tax penalty waivers; UNICEF launched health campaign; sealed 14 unapproved schools.
KATSINA (PSI 8.7): Commissioned Matazu water scheme (17 wells); delivered 100 motorcycles and skills center; granted ₦50k each to 250 trainees; secured EU ECHO funding.
PLATEAU (PSI 8.6): Flagged off full asphaltation of 41km Bisichi–Mangu road; installed HRH Jerome Leklak II as Long Pan; received FG approval for Mararaban Jama'a–Shendam road.
EDO (PSI 8.5): Averted Ojirami Dam disaster via partial water release; HOS advanced e-governance and 50 CNG buses; First Lady/MTN distributed school bags; opened SDG bids.
ANAMBRA (PSI 8.3): Enforced ceasefire in Aguleri-Umuoba Anam crisis, ordered prosecution of killers, pledged state support to rebuild Idigo Palace, and created Commission of Inquiry.
ENUGU (PSI 8.2): Unveiled 10-year Education Policy focused on Smart Green Schools and experiential learning; appointed Barr. Richard Agu as Transport Commissioner-Designate.
ONDO (PSI 8.0): Gov Aiyedatiwa visited Air Force aircraft crash site in Igbokoda, coordinating search and recovery operations with NEMA, military, and local marine units.
DELTA (PSI 7.9): Inspected Odidi Community spill site (216 communities affected); directed Heritage Energy to supply medical relief/cleanup; approved Odidi landing jetty.
GOMBE (PSI 7.4): Federal Fire Service saved ₦3.117 billion in property across 24 incidents; GOSEPA completed 2-day hygiene and sanitation training for school clubs.
ADAMAWA (PSI 7.1): Ministry of Energy opened public bids for 11km 132kV double-circuit power transmission line and towers from Wuro Ngayadi to Gulak.
ZAMFARA (PSI 7.0): TSB Chairperson inspected TRCN compliance and data-capturing exercises across schools in Kaura Namoda LGA to verify teacher qualifications.
OYO (PSI 6.8): Akinyele LGA commenced construction of 3.5km dual carriageway rigid pavement road connecting Moniya-Iseyin highway to new Container Terminal.
EKITI (PSI 6.5): State Executive Council approved 2027–2029 Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) for transmission to the State House of Assembly.
BAYELSA (PSI 6.2): Reviewed 6 years of Assured Prosperity Agenda on 30th state anniversary, highlighting 3 Senatorial roads, 60MW Gas Turbine IPP, and vocational colleges.
